action_requested.text_hi: Aaj hi ek personal-style UPI par ₹X bhejna, aur ghar mein kisi ko na batana.
action_requested.text_en: Send ₹X to a personal-style UPI today, and keep it secret from family.

items.label: CONTRADICTED
items.title_hi: IPO ke liye kisi aur ke UPI par paisa
items.title_en: Paying a personal UPI for an IPO
items.why_hi: IPO mein aap apne hi UPI se bid karte hain aur paise aapke apne khate mein block hote hain. Yeh SEBI ke bataye tareeke se match nahi karta.
items.why_en: In an IPO you bid with your own UPI and funds are blocked in your own account. This does not match the standard flow described by SEBI.
items.settle_hi: Apne broker ya bank app mein IPO ka bid dekhein.
items.settle_en: Check the IPO bid inside your own broker or bank app.

items.label: CONTRADICTED
items.why_hi: SEBI ki chetavni mein aise daave dhokhe ke sanket ginaye gaye hain. Yeh unse match karta hai.
items.why_en: SEBI's advisory lists such claims as warning signs. This matches them.

items.label: COULDNT_VERIFY
items.title_hi: Payee ka UPI SEBI-validated nahi dikhta
items.title_en: Payee UPI does not look SEBI-validated
items.why_hi: Yeh ek aam vyakti jaisa UPI lagta hai. Hum ise verify nahi kar sake.
items.why_en: It looks like an ordinary personal UPI. We could not verify it.
items.settle_hi: SEBI Check par payee daalkar dekhein.
items.settle_en: Search the payee on SEBI Check.

items.label: COULDNT_VERIFY
items.title_hi: Sandesh mein registration number likha hai
items.why_hi: Number copy kiya ja sakta hai. Registry mein milna sirf firm ka hona batata hai, ki aap usi se baat kar rahe hain.
items.why_en: A number can be copied. A registry hit shows the firm exists, not that this sender is that firm.
items.settle_hi: Firm ka contact SEBI ke page se lein, chat ke number se nahi.
items.settle_en: Get the firm's contact from SEBI's page, not from numbers in the chat.

items.label: AI_INTERPRETATION
items.why_hi: "Aaj hi" aur "ghar mein mat batana" aapko sochne aur puchne se rokte hain.
items.why_en: "Today only" and "don't tell family" stop you from thinking and asking.

stage.name: DEPOSIT_PUSH
stage.because_hi: Kyunki sandesh mein paise bhejne ki maang hai.
stage.because_en: Because the message asks you to send money.
